# tarae-netlink's fixtures: what nft 1.1.3 and iproute2 6.15 sent the kernel (Debian 12, Linux 6.1, each case in
# a user + network namespace of its own) and what it answered — from strace's logs of capture/r6-inner.sh and
# r6b-inner.sh, kept by capture/fixtures.sh (how to make them again: capture/vm.sh). Per case: the command, the last
# datagram sent (>), the kernel's answers (<), each datagram hex, 64 bytes a line, two spaces before a continuation.

=== rule-out-dns
